claims.statement: Official sources confirm fingerprint verification, blood testing, blood sample analysis, and microscopic examination as full-game systems.
Official update notes and launch observations confirm forged medical certificates as a distinct inspection condition.
The observed launch route introduces sample collection, microscope inspection, and result printing on Day 21.
The observed launch route introduces blood type testing on Day 29.
Observed shift rules assign different actions to different named microscopic findings and blood types, so abnormal results are not interchangeable.

unknowns: The retained Day 1–30 walkthrough does not establish an exact fingerprint unlock day.
No universal full-release fingerprint match-state table was available.
Blood findings and action rules may change by shift, patch, or branch.
